fun_fact: Rice is getting pricier across South India. Deficit rains in June and July — worsened by El Niño — along with the West Asia war and local supply pressures have pushed up the cost of everything from everyday Sona Masuri to prized Karnataka specialities like Jeera Samba and Mysore Mallige. [Read more](https://www.deccanherald.com/india/drought-fears-drive-up-rice-prices-across-south-india-4096888)
